23Apr
23–25 ✓Center Ride OutRidingLos Angeles, CA · charity ride · LGBTQ+ · 3 days · 200+ miles over 3 days (Day 3 = 80+ miles); Day 2… · Los Angeles guide →Details
Dates
Fri, April 23, 2027 – Sun, April 25, 2027
Where
Los Angeles, CA
Route
Los Angeles → Los Angeles (2027 route: LA to Ojai and back; 2026 route was LA to San Diego)
Distances
200+ miles over 3 days (Day 3 = 80+ miles); Day 2 choose-your-own-adventure loops; 1-Day Rider option (Day 2 only). 2026 route was 285 miles LA-Lake Skinner (Temecula)-San Diego.
Format
LGBTQ/HIV multi-day (3-day, camping)
Cause
LGBTQ+ — Los Angeles LGBT Center (HIV services, housing, youth/senior, gender-affirming care); in 2026, 10% of net proceeds each to San Diego LGBT Community Center and LGBTQ Community Center of the Desert
Min. fundraising
$2,500 (2026 minimum, due April 10, 2026; $95 registration). 2027 minimum not visible on pages fetched - likely unchanged, verify on official FAQ.
Organizer
Los Angeles LGBT Center
Registration
Open for 2027 (give.lalgbtcenter.org/event/center-ride-out-2027/e775406); first-come registration, not a lottery (2026 was capped at 525 participants)

DateLos Angeles Blade (Apr 28, 2026) and The Pride LA (May 2026) report registration open for the 2027 ride on April 23-25, 2027; official events page (re-checked Oct 1, 2026) lists the Finish Line Festival on April 25, 2027, 12-8 pm, location still TBD. Inaugural 2026 ride was April 24-26, 2026.

NotesSuccessor event to AIDS/LifeCycle on the LA side. 2026 inaugural ride raised ~$830,511 with ~300 cyclists. IMPORTANT: official site now describes the route as 'Ride from Los Angeles to Ojai, camp with your friends, and cruise back along the coast' - i.e., the 2027 route appears to be an LA-Ojai-LA loop rather than LA-to-San Diego. Finish-line festival location listed as TBD. Official site (Oct 1, 2026) pitches the Ojai stop as 'Queer Summer Camp' (swimming, canoeing, lakeside DJ set); Register Now buttons live, no sell-out notice seen.

Event siteSources: https://centerrideout.lalgbtcenter.org/en/ https://centerrideout.lalgbtcenter.org/events/

21–23 ✓Cycle to ZeroRidingSan Francisco → San Francisco / Sausalito · charity ride · HIV/AIDS · 3 days · Day 1 SF to Guerneville ~85 mi; Day 2…Details
Dates
Fri, May 21, 2027 – Sun, May 23, 2027
Where
San Francisco, CA
Route
San Francisco (2026 start: Fort Baker, Sausalito) → San Francisco / Sausalito (2026 finish: Martin Luther King Park, Sausalito)
Distances
Day 1 SF to Guerneville ~85 mi; Day 2 choose-your-own-adventure ~40 mi or ~100-mi century (2026 offered 38/65/104); Day 3 Guerneville to SF ~85 mi. Camping at Camp Russian River and Johnson's Beach, Guerneville.
Format
HIV/AIDS multi-day (3-day, camping)
Cause
HIV/AIDS — San Francisco AIDS Foundation (HIV care/prevention, sexual health, substance-use and overdose-prevention programs)
Min. fundraising
3-Day Cyclist $500 by March 1, 2027 to hold a spot and $2,500 total by May 1, 2027 per the FAQ (the home page says May 4, 2027, so confirm); Crew $250 by May 1 (FAQ) / May 4 (home page). Registration fees: 3-Day $95, 1-Day $225 (no minimum), Crew $95, DIY Squad $45 (waitlist free)
Organizer
San Francisco AIDS Foundation
Registration
Open for 2027 (donate.sfaf.org/event/cycle-to-zero-2027/e804781); limited capacity with waitlist, not a lottery; registrations non-refundable

DateOfficial 2027 site and FAQ state May 21-23, 2027 (1-Day option Saturday May 22, 2027). 2026 edition was May 29-31, 2026. Re-checked Oct 1, 2026: home page and FAQ both show May 21-23, 2027, with the 1-Day option on Saturday May 22.

NotesSuccessor event to AIDS/LifeCycle on the SF side; 2026 inaugural edition had 700+ cyclists/crew and raised $1.6M+. Includes a DIY Squad remote-participation tier (not counted as an in-person ride option).

Event siteSources: https://2027.cycletozero.org/ https://2027.cycletozero.org/faqs/

Registration

DateCascade Bicycle Club has published the 2027 dates on its dedicated STP 2027 page (Sat-Sun, July 10-11, 2027). Re-checked Oct 1, 2026: page still shows Sat Jul 10, 5:00 am to Sun Jul 11, 7:00 pm, 2027.

NotesThe largest multi-day bicycle event in the Pacific Northwest (~8,000 riders). Finishes in Portland, OR. Add-ons (parking, bus pass, bike transport) purchased via participant dashboard after registration opens.
